# CLI Command Reference

<div className="amber-generated-banner">
  <strong>Reference generated from Amber Protocol v2.0.2</strong><br />
  Authoritative command vocabulary: 53 commands
</div>

Amber Protocol exposes its governance capabilities through a single unified CLI entry point `amber` (or `node scripts/amber.js`).

Default help lists `audit`, `init`, `doctor`, `next`, `plan`, `handoff`, `session`. Run `amber --all` to list every command; experimental families are marked there. Stability is a separate registry field (`core` | `experimental`) and is independent of the visibility tier.

## Standard Command Invocations

All commands accept `--target <repo>` to specify the path to the target repository being governed.

```bash
amber <command> --target <repo> [options]
```
